extracted.intended_audience: clinical researchers and translational oncologists working on CAR T-cell therapy for pediatric CNS tumors
extracted.subtask_short: phase I CAR T-cell trial methods
extracted.subtask_description: Methods and operational criteria for a phase I dose-escalation GD2-CAR T-cell trial in children and young adults with H3K27M+ diffuse midline gliomas (DIPG and spinal DMG), covering eligibility, toxicity management, manufacturing, administration, biomarker assays, and response assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary trial objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary objectives are assessing feasibility of manufacturing, safety and tolerability, and identifying the maximally tolerated dose or recommended phase II dose in a 3+3 dose-escalation design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design uses classic 3+3 escalation; feasibility includes ability to manufacture autologous GD2-CAR T cells. Clinical activity is a secondary objective and correlative biomarker identification is exploratory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Toxicity management plan (TIAN and CRS)
rubrics_metrics.description: A pre-specified toxicity management algorithm to mitigate inflammation-induced swelling (TIAN) and cytokine release syndrome (CRS), including pre-emptive measures and specific interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TIAN management includes CSF removal via Ommaya reservoir, hypertonic saline and/or corticosteroids; CRS management includes anti-cytokine agents (tocilizumab, anakinra) and corticosteroids. Intensive inpatient supportive care and routine/symptom-prompted intracranial pressure (ICP) measurements are required. An inducible suicide switch (iCasp9 activated by rimiducid) is included for life-threatening, unmanageable toxicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of high-risk neuroanatomical disease
rubrics_metrics.description: Exclude patients with bulky thalamic or cerebellar tumours (or other investigator-assessed lesions) that place the participant at unacceptable risk for herniation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pontocerebellar peduncle involvement is allowed; exclusion is based on investigator judgment of unacceptable herniation risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ommaya reservoir requirement for DIPG patients
rubrics_metrics.description: Patients with DIPG are required to have placement of an Ommaya reservoir prior to treatment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ommaya facilitates CSF sampling and CSF drainage as part of TIAN management and for i.c.v. administration when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informed consent and oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: IRB approval and external DSMB oversight are required; written informed consent from patients/parents and minor assent when appropriate must be obtained before enrolment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DSMB reviews protocol, amendments, and major patient events. Consent must also cover use of photos/videos for scientific presentations/publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: disease status
rubrics_metrics.description: Tissue-confirmed H3K27M-mutated DIPG with radiographically evident tumour restricted to brainstem, or tissue-confirmed H3K27M-mutated spinal cord DMG.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines cohort eligibility separately for dose-escalation and expansion cohorts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: age range
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligible participants must be ≥2 years and ≤30 years of age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers both paediatric and young adult populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: prior therapy timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Must be at least 4 weeks after completion of front-line radiation therapy, and at least 3 weeks post-chemotherapy or five half-lives (whichever is shorter); systemic checkpoint immunotherapy requires 3 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures adequate recovery from prior therapies before CAR T administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: performance status
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants >16 years: Karnofsky ≥60% or ECOG 0–1; participants ≤16 years: Lansky scale ≥60%. Wheelchair-bound but up in a wheelchair counts as ambulatory for scoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits some disability while ensuring baseline functional reserve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: organ and marrow function thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Hematologic and organ function requirements: ANC ≥1,000/µl; platelets ≥100,000/µl; absolute lymphocyte count ≥150/µl; haemoglobin ≥8 g/dl; creatinine within institutional norms or CrCl ≥60 ml/min; ALT/AST ≤3.0 × ULN; total bilirubin ≤1.5 mg/dl (except Gilbert's); cardiac EF ≥45%; baseline O2 saturation >92% on room air.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supportive care (e.g., filgrastim, transfusion) is allowed per institutional standards. Cardiac and ECG assessments used to determine physiologic significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: reproductive status and contraception
rubrics_metrics.description: Female individuals of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test; participants of childbearing/child-fathering potential must use contraception from enrolment and for 4 months after lymphodepletion or while GD2-CAR T cells are detectable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Surgical sterilization exempts female individuals from pregnancy testing requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion: consent capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants must be able to give informed consent; paediatric participants included in age-appropriate discussion with written assent obtained for those ≥7 years when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures legal and ethical enrollment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: corticosteroid therapy
rubrics_metrics.description: Current systemic corticosteroid therapy excludes participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corticosteroids may blunt CAR T activity and confound toxicity/response assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: prior CAR therapy
rubrics_metrics.description: Any previous CAR T-cell therapy excludes participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoids confounding by prior CAR exposures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: uncontrolled infection or certain viral infections
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncontrolled fungal, bacterial, viral or other infection excludes participation. Ongoing HIV or hepatitis B (HBsAg positive) or hepatitis C (anti-HCV positive) excludes participation unless viral load is undetectable per qPCR/nucleic acid testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Previously diagnosed infection under responding antimicrobial therapy is permitted if clinically stable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: significant systemic illness
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinically significant systemic illness (e.g., cardiac, pulmonary, hepatic dysfunction) that could interfere with safety/efficacy assessment excludes participation at PI judgment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigator discretion to assess interference with protocol procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: likelihood of noncompliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Participants unlikely to complete protocol-required visits/procedures or comply with study requirements are excluded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessed by investigator judgment prior to enrolment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion: allergy or immune conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Known sensitivity/allergy to study agents or reagents, primary immunodeficiency, or autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppression/disease-modifying agents within past 2 years excludes participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of autoimmune conditions include Crohn's, rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radiographic response assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Radiographic responses evaluated by gadolinium-enhanced MRI with volumetric tumour segmentation of T2/FLAIR signal abnormality due to diffuse infiltrative nature of DMGs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Volumetric segmentation performed by a neuroradiologist to measure radiographic change rather than simple bidimensional measurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical response assessment (Clinical Improvement Score — CIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: CIS is an unweighted neurological exam-based score: for each neurological symptom/sign, +1 for improvement, 0 for no change, −1 for worsening; total is sum of points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conducted by a neurologist at baseline and designated post-therapy timepoints. Assessment not performed within 7 days of corticosteroid administration. Sample forms available in supplementary material.

rubrics_metrics.name: CAR T-cell manufacturing process
rubrics_metrics.description: Autologous PBMCs collected by apheresis; CD4 and CD8 T cells selected and transduced with a bicistronic retroviral vector encoding iCasp9 and GD2–4-1BB–CD3ζ (14g2a scFv under MSCV promoter); expanded 7 days with recombinant human IL-7 and IL-15 and dasatinib added on days 3 and 5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Closed-system CliniMACS Prodigy used for manufacturing; dasatinib addition intended to improve T-cell fitness.

rubrics_metrics.name: CAR T-cell administration and lymphodepletion regimen
rubrics_metrics.description: Lymphodepletion with cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m2 daily and fludarabine 25 mg/m2 daily on days −4, −3, −2 followed by i.v. CAR T infusion on day 0; monitoring inpatient including routine ICP measurements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Second infusions administered i.c.v. via the Ommaya. First i.c.v. treated patient received flat 50 million CAR T cells after intensified lymphodepletion under single-patient eIND; subsequent i.c.v. doses were 30 million or equivalent weight-based DL1 dose without lymphodepletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: qPCR assay for in vivo CAR expansion — assay design and QC
rubrics_metrics.description: qPCR quantification of GD2-CAR copies using albumin normalization and a custom Minigene plasmid standard curve (10-fold dilutions from 5×10^8 to 5×10^0 copies), running plasmid and patient DNA in triplicate with 50 ng DNA per reaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primer/probe concentrations and reaction volumes specified; instrument: QuantStudio 6 Pro. Quality metrics: R^2 > 0.95 and efficiency between 70–110%. Copy number calculation: copy number (copies per 100 ng DNA) = 2 × (GD2-CAR copy number × (albumin copy number / average albumin)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) ddPCR workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: CSF samples centrifuged (1,800g 10 min at 4°C then 20,000g 10 min), supernatant frozen at −80°C; DNA extracted from 0.5–3 ml CSF; 7 PCR cycles pre-amplification on 10 µl input followed by ddPCR (40 cycles) run as 4–6 technical replicates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assay design includes forward/reverse primers and mutant/wild-type probes for H3F3A K27M; dilution series used to validate linearity and limit of detection. All runs contain positive and negative controls; results analysed in R to plot VAF and mutation counts per volume over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-dimensional real-time flow cytometry assay parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: PBMC isolation by Ficoll; staining with viability and antibody panel (15-colour, 17-parameter); acquisition on a five-laser LSR with at least 10^6 cells acquired unless limited by sample; assay limit of detection calculated as 1 in 10^4 of acquired PBMCs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CAR-transduced T cells used as positive control daily; representative gating provided in Extended Data. Acquisition constrained by available cell numbers from whole blood or CSF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Luminex cytokine assay workflow and QC
rubrics_metrics.description: Blood and CSF samples spun, supernatant frozen at −80°C and batched; samples diluted (3× or 10× depending on panel); incubated with antibody-linked magnetic beads overnight; read on Luminex FlexMap3D with lower bound of 50 beads per sample per cytokine; data reported as pg/ml or heatmap fold-change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Custom Assay Chex control beads used in all wells. All wells must meet QC bead count >50. Samples run in technical duplicate. Manufacturer kits used per recommendations with described modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA-seq library generation and processing pipeline
rubrics_metrics.description: 5′ v2 Single Cell Immune Profiling (10x Genomics) with targeted cell concentrations (700–1,200 cells/µl), GEM generation, cDNA recovery/amplification, library QC by Bioanalyzer, sequencing on NovaSeq, Cell Ranger (v6.0.0+) for processing, and creation of a custom reference appending CAR segments to GRCh38 to optimize CAR detection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FASTQ probing by SeqKit to identify CAR segments; Cell Ranger mkref used to build reference; alignment via cellranger count.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA-seq filtering and normalization criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Exclude cells with >15% UMIs mapping to mitochondrial genes or <300 genes detected; exclude doublets with >10,000 genes or >50,000 UMIs; subsample to 5,000 cells per sample; normalize combined data using SCTransform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integration across patients using RPCA; PCA excludes TCR/BCR genes; curated T-cell/function genes included among variable genes; UMAP embedding using first 50 PCs; downstream Seurat pipelines (FindMarkers, AddModuleScore) used.

rubrics_metrics.name: scRNA-seq clustering and DEG identification thresholds
rubrics_metrics.description: Graph-based clustering with Harmony batch correction (first 30 PCs, default params), choose first 20 Harmony dimensions for UMAP, cluster with Louvain (FindClusters), identify DEGs detected in ≥30% of cells of a cluster with ≥0.5 mean log fold difference using Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni correction and adjusted P < 0.05.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cell clusters annotated by manual inspection of top DEGs and enrichment of GO biological processes compared to published datasets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene signature scoring for cell states
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute single-cell expression scores as average scaled expression (Z-score) of gene set Gj minus average scaled expression of control gene set Gcont where each gene's control set contains 100 genes with most similar aggregated expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implementation uses Seurat AddModuleScore/FeaturePlot functions; used to score DAM and MDSC signatures among others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of myeloid and lineage doublets
rubrics_metrics.description: Myeloid fractions identified using module scores for AIF1, CSF1R, CX3CR1, CD14, CD68 and CD163; lineage doublets defined as cells expressing markers of >1 lineage (T cells: CD2, CD3E, CD3D, CD3G, CD247, CD7 and GD2-CAR; B cells: CD19, CD22, PAX5; microglia/myeloid: CD14, CD68, CD163, CSF1R, AIF1; astrocytes: GFAP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Doublets and lineage-mixed cells are identified and excluded/annotated during analysis to prevent misclassification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flow cytometry and assay controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Include CAR-transduced T cells as positive controls in daily staining experiments and use fixable live/dead viability stain and Fc block prior to staining.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Panel and fluorochrome specifications provided in supplementary table; acquisition settings and gating strategy referenced in Extended Data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Histology and immunostaining standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Immunohistochemistry conducted on formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue per standard protocols (deparaffinization, antigen retrieval, primary antibody incubation, detection) with specified antibodies and dilutions for markers such as CD3, CD4, CD8, CD163; automated stainers and antigen retrieval conditions specified per marker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GD2 and H3K27M assays described separately; platform-specific reagents and conditions (Ventana, Leica, Dako) called out for reproducibility.
